In particular \(z_k^2\bar z_j\) produces the missing pairwise second harmonic. Projecting the stated controller term by term gives exactly \(-f_j^{(2)}\); because the controller enters at order \(\varepsilon^2\), deformation/cross terms begin only at order \(\varepsilon^3\). The inspected symbolic verifier independently reduces the full residual to zero and enumerates the relevant cubic phase vectors.
